items.title: Debian won’t ban AI code from its Linux distribution
items.summary: Debian voted to allow developers to use AI tools in their contributions to the Linux distribution's "development, maintenance, [and] documentation." items.title: ChatGPT to face tougher regulation in the EU
items.summary: OpenAI will soon be held accountable for mitigating risks related to ChatGPT's impact on minors, user mental health, and the spread of illegal content in the European Union. items.title: Instagram cracks down on AI accounts pretending to be human
items.summary: Instagram is finally taking steps to address the rise of fake AI-influencer accounts that have gotten harder to spot. It's also renaming the "AI creator" label to "AI-generated profile" to make it clear when a profile features an AI-generated person that's not a real human being.
